title: Shia LaBeouf "Just Do It" Motivational Speech (Original Video by LaBeouf, Rönkkö & Turner)
summary: A one-minute motivational clip from the art piece #INTRODUCTIONS in which Shia LaBeouf shouts "Just Do It" in front of a green screen. It spawned many remixes.
why: HN mostly uses it as a joke or meme reply to questions about motivation and procrastination, and as the source of a widely remixed clip.
